name: KEB Berhad
overview: 2026年，KEB Berhad 完成首次公开募股并在 Bursa Malaysia ACE 市场上市，发行 138,535,000 股新股。公司业务仍以房地产开发与销售为主，未公告其他业务板块的扩张、缩减或退出。
overview_en: In 2026, KEB Berhad completed its initial public offering and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia, issuing 138,535,000 new shares. The company's business remains focused on property development and sales, with no announcements of expansion, reduction, or exit in other business segments.

segments.name: 房地产开发与销售
segments.note: 今年公司完成 IPO 并上市，业务仍为在马来西亚开发及销售住宅、工业、商业及综合用途物业。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO and listing this year; its business remains the development and sale of residential, industrial, commercial, and mixed-use properties in Malaysia.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH OUR LISTING ON THE ACE MARKET OF BURSA MALAYSIA SECURITIES BERHAD ("BURSA SECURITIES") C
actions.text: 完成首次公开募股，发行 138,535,000 股新股，并在 Bursa Malaysia ACE 市场上市。
actions.text_en: Completed its initial public offering, issuing 138,535,000 new shares and listing on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia.

model_changes.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH OUR LISTING ON THE ACE MARKET OF BURSA MALAYSIA SECURITIES BERHAD ("BURSA SECURITIES") C
model_changes.text: 公司通过首次公开募股成为上市公司，在 Bursa Malaysia ACE 市场上市。
model_changes.text_en: The company became a listed entity through an initial public offering and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia.
